description: §22.4.1 (S459 round 4 F4) — `xlink:href` and a MathML `href` (leading space) with `javascript:` in compile-time `emit()` output are E-META-EVAL-002.
rationale: §22.4.1 + §22.12 *URL attributes*: the URL-valued set is element-insensitive; the reader strips leading spaces as the URL parser does. (S459 round 4, PA decisions on the S459 final review — bryan "go")
